result.p: All Settings 显示配置文件的预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 You know where the configured value came from and can explain the impact of changing it.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请清除筛选器、返回详细信息面板或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if source attribution is ambiguous, compare the profile with a clean baseline or inspect the imported source document.
